tools.description: Talk to Wizzo, WizTrip's travel agent from wiz-trip.com/arma-tu-viaje, to build a trip: destinations, dates, travellers, flights and hotels, single or multi-city. tools.name: trip_choose
tools.description: Choose one of the flight or hotel options Wizzo showed in trip_chat, for the trip `trip_id`: `kind` is "vuelo" or "hotel", `cache_id` is the card's cache_id and `id` the option's id. tools.name: trip_view
tools.description: Show the trip `trip_id` as it stands: legs, nights, chosen flight and hotels with their WizTrip prices in USD, the total, what is still missing and, when it can be booked, the card's «Reservar ahora» button. Does not talk to Wizzo.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_hotels · Private data: search_transfers · Public sink: trip_chat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_hotels · Private data: search_transfers · Public sink: trip_chat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
